purpose: Keep enterprise-owned property and building authority separate from shared state rule packs and tenant-file evidence.

authority_boundaries.platform_state_pack: Official public statutes, agency manuals, notices, limits, blank forms, and validated state release metadata maintained by CertivoIQ.
authority_boundaries.enterprise_project_authority: Recorded LURAs, Forms 8609, regulatory agreements, HAP contracts, waivers, amendments, and project schedules uploaded for an authorized organization and property.
authority_boundaries.enterprise_tenant_file: Applications, leases, certifications, income, asset, student, and household evidence; these records are rejected by this intake boundary.

controls: Trusted server authorization fixes organization, user, property, state, building, and program scope.
Actual file bytes must match a unique SHA-256 identity and pass byte-derived classification.
Building-scoped Form 8609 records identify exactly one authorized BIN.
Updates are append-only, versioned, and linked to the current document in a compatible lineage.
Federal project-authority completeness remains visible when state-pack reconciliation is blocked.
State-specific downstream handoff requires a validated state-pack registry receipt.
state_pack_sequence: Additional state releases after official-source and effective-date validation
